column1: 1|人造石墨由碳质原料经热处理形成，常用于电池负极及导电配方。|Artificial graphite is produced by heat treatment of carbon feedstocks and is used in battery anodes and conductive formulations.|先区分石墨化后颗粒与包覆后团聚体；解聚时保持包覆层，整形时同时比较振实密度、细粉比例与收率。|Distinguish graphitized particles from agglomerates formed after coating. Deagglomeration should preserve the coating; shaping trials should compare tap density, fines and yield.|graphite

2|沥青是碳质黏结和包覆原料，粉体级材料需按来源与软化点区分，不同于直接使用的道路沥青。|Pitch is a carbonaceous binder and coating feedstock. Powder grades are distinguished by origin and softening point and should not be confused with road asphalt.|高软化点牌号与普通牌号的可加工温度不同；先测软化和黏壁趋势，再确定进料粒度、气体温度及粉碎后的流动性。|High-softening-point and conventional grades have different processing windows. Establish softening and wall adhesion before choosing feed size, gas temperature and powder flow targets.|heat

3|勃姆石是氢氧化氧铝粉体，可用于电池隔膜涂层及陶瓷原料；粉体本身并不等同于完整隔膜。|Boehmite is an aluminium oxyhydroxide powder used in battery-separator coatings and ceramic feedstocks; the powder is not a complete separator.|涂覆用途重点控制粗粒与团聚，兼顾浆料分散；评估蒸汽等热气源时，应同时检查相态、含水和表面性质是否变化。|For coatings, control coarse particles and agglomerates while checking slurry dispersion. Any heated-gas or steam route must also be assessed for phase, moisture and surface-property changes.|cathode

4|硬碳是难以石墨化的碳材料，是钠离子电池负极材料的重要研究与应用方向。|Hard carbon is a non-graphitizing carbon used and investigated as an anode material for sodium-ion batteries.|控制粒度的同时保留孔结构；粉碎前后对比比表面积、细粉增量及颗粒完整性，不能仅凭粒径推断电化学表现。|Retain pore structure while controlling particle size. Compare surface area, new fines and particle integrity before and after milling; size alone does not establish electrochemical performance.|porous

5|磷酸铁是磷酸铁锂等材料的前驱体，干燥后粉体的团聚状态会影响后续混合。|Iron phosphate is a precursor for materials such as lithium iron phosphate, and agglomeration after drying affects subsequent mixing.|区分软团聚解聚与一次颗粒破碎；以混料均匀性、含水和异物控制为选型输入，避免把前驱体处理与成品正极粉碎混为同一步。|Separate soft-agglomerate dispersion from primary-particle fracture. Use mixing uniformity, moisture and contamination limits as inputs; precursor processing and finished-cathode milling are distinct tasks.|cathode

6|层状氧化物是一类具有层状晶体结构的正极材料，锂电和钠电体系的成分与环境敏感性各不相同。|Layered oxides are a family of cathode materials with layered crystal structures; lithium- and sodium-based compositions have different handling requirements.|提交具体化学体系、包覆状态和单晶/多晶形态；按二次颗粒强度选择解聚强度，并控制暴露于湿气后的变化。|Specify chemistry, coating and single-crystal or polycrystalline morphology. Match deagglomeration intensity to secondary-particle strength and assess changes caused by moisture exposure.|cathode

7|磷酸铁锂（LFP）是锂离子电池正极粉体，烧结及干燥后可能需要解聚和粒径整理。|Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) is a lithium-ion cathode powder that may require deagglomeration and size control after calcination or drying.|需要同时明确碳包覆状态、团聚强度及微水分目标；粉碎与干燥是否合并，要以水分、温度和产品性能的联合试验决定。|Define carbon-coating condition, agglomerate strength and residual-moisture targets. Combining drying and milling requires joint verification of moisture, temperature and product performance.|cathode

8|碳酸锂是制备多种锂电正极材料的锂源，粉体均匀性关系到后续配料和反应。|Lithium carbonate is a lithium source for several cathode chemistries; powder uniformity matters for subsequent blending and reaction.|以混料反应所需粒度为目标，控制粗颗粒、含水和外来金属；比较机械粉碎与气流路线时应记录完整系统能耗和收集率。|Set size targets for blending and reaction, with limits for coarse particles, moisture and foreign metals. Compare impact and jet routes using whole-system energy and collection recovery.|clean

9|氢氧化锂可作为锂电正极的锂源，需明确无水或一水合物等具体商品形态。|Lithium hydroxide is a lithium source for cathode production; specify the commercial form, including anhydrous or monohydrate grades.|重点控制吸湿、结团和碳酸化；用隔湿投料、受控气氛及密闭收集减少环境接触，材料相容性与气体露点需一起评估。|Control moisture uptake, caking and carbonation. Assess enclosed feeding, controlled atmosphere and sealed collection together with contact-material compatibility and gas dew point.|moisture

10|磷酸锰铁锂（LMFP）是含锰、铁的磷酸盐正极材料，常以复合或包覆粉体形态进入后续制浆。|Lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) is a manganese–iron phosphate cathode material often supplied as composite or coated powder.|关注烧结团聚、碳包覆保持与分散性；工艺评价应同时检查粒度分布及批次均匀性，不能直接照搬LFP设定。|Evaluate sintered agglomerates, coating retention and dispersibility. Check size distribution and batch consistency rather than transferring LFP settings unchanged.|cathode

11|镍钴铝酸锂（NCA）是含镍、钴、铝的层状锂离子电池正极氧化物，与磷酸铁锂属于不同材料体系。|Lithium nickel cobalt aluminium oxide (NCA) is a layered lithium-ion cathode oxide containing nickel, cobalt and aluminium; it is a different chemistry from LFP.|烧结后的解聚应减少一次颗粒损伤；按镍含量、洗涤干燥状态、表面残碱和含水要求评估闭式粉碎与收集。|Limit primary-particle damage during post-calcination deagglomeration. Assess closed milling and collection against nickel content, washing/drying condition, surface residues and moisture requirements.|cathode

12|镍钴锰酸锂（NCM/NMC）是锂离子电池的三元正极材料，牌号和颗粒结构影响粉体加工方式。|Lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide (NCM/NMC) is a ternary lithium-ion cathode material whose grade and particle structure affect powder processing.|先判断任务是烧结块破碎还是二次颗粒解聚；应对比包覆完整性、细粉增加和金属杂质，避免为追求小粒径破坏目标形貌。|Establish whether the task is breaking sintered lumps or dispersing secondary-particle agglomerates. Compare coating integrity, added fines and metal contamination while preserving the intended morphology.|cathode

13|天然石墨来自含石墨矿物，片状原料用于负极时通常需要粒径和形貌整理。|Natural graphite is derived from graphite-bearing minerals; flake feedstocks used for anodes often require size and morphology control.|球化与脱细应分开评价；通过显微形貌、振实密度和产品/细粉质量平衡判断路线，保留片状用途则不宜默认球化。|Evaluate spheroidization and fines removal separately using microscopy, tap density and a product/fines mass balance. Flake-preserving applications should not default to spheroidization.|graphite

14|多孔碳是一类具有孔隙结构的碳材料，可用于吸附、载体及储能相关配方。|Porous carbons contain a pore network and are used in adsorption, support materials and energy-storage formulations.|粒径缩小不等于孔结构改善；检查孔容、比表面积和吸附/配方需求，优先去除团聚与过粗颗粒，避免无目的过粉碎。|Smaller particles do not necessarily improve pore structure. Evaluate pore volume, surface area and end-use requirements, prioritizing agglomerates and coarse particles over excessive grinding.|porous

15|硅碳复合（Si/C）是硅与碳组成的复合负极材料，不能与硬质磨料碳化硅（SiC）混同。|Silicon–carbon composites (Si/C) combine silicon and carbon for anode use and are distinct from silicon carbide (SiC) abrasives.|区分包覆型、复合颗粒和烧结团聚体；解聚以保留碳层与复合结构为前提，并比较新增细粉、氧含量和分散性。|Distinguish coated particles, composite particles and sintered agglomerates. Deagglomeration should preserve carbon layers and composite structure while assessing added fines, oxygen content and dispersion.|cathode

16|硅氧碳复合（SiO/C）指含硅氧相与碳的负极复合粉体，具体组成需由牌号说明。|Silicon-oxide/carbon composites (SiO/C) contain a silicon-oxide phase and carbon for anode use; the grade determines the actual composition.|说明硅氧相、碳包覆和预处理状态；选择温和解聚或粒度分级，并比较表面状态与吸湿变化，不将SiOC陶瓷自动视为同一原料。|Specify the silicon-oxide phase, carbon coating and pretreatment. Compare gentle deagglomeration or classification with surface and moisture changes; SiOC ceramics are not automatically the same feedstock.|cathode

17|磷酸铁钠是钠基磷酸盐电极材料，具体晶相和组成决定其用途，属于钠电材料讨论范围。|Sodium iron phosphate is a sodium-based phosphate electrode material; its phase and composition determine its application within sodium-ion systems.|提供晶相、碳复合状态及含水情况；工艺目标是可控解聚、均匀配料和密闭收集，粉碎并不替代材料合成或晶相调控。|Provide phase identity, carbon-composite condition and moisture. Target controlled deagglomeration, uniform blending and enclosed collection; milling does not replace synthesis or phase control.|cathode

18|磷酸钒钠通常指Na3V2(PO4)3等钠基磷酸盐材料，用于钠离子电池相关电极体系。|Sodium vanadium phosphate commonly refers to sodium phosphate materials such as Na3V2(PO4)3 used in sodium-ion electrode systems.|关注碳包覆、硬团聚和钒元素物料的粉尘收集；用粒度与显微观察判断解聚效果，电池性能需由后续电极测试评价。|Focus on carbon coating, hard agglomerates and containment of vanadium-bearing dust. Assess deagglomeration by size analysis and microscopy; electrode testing is needed to evaluate battery performance.|cathode

19|特种碳是按用途定义的碳材料集合，可能涉及导电、结构或储能配方，并非单一化学牌号。|Specialty carbon covers application-defined carbon materials for conductive, structural or energy-storage formulations rather than one chemical grade.|先明确焦类、石墨类或多孔碳身份，再确定粉碎、解聚或整形任务；灰分、挥发分和形貌是路线比较的必要输入。|Identify coke, graphite or porous-carbon feedstock before deciding on grinding, deagglomeration or shaping. Ash, volatiles and morphology are essential route-selection inputs.|assess

20|氧化铝是陶瓷、填料和抛光材料常用的氧化物，晶相及煅烧程度会改变粉碎行为。|Alumina is an oxide used in ceramics, fillers and polishing materials; phase and calcination history influence its milling behaviour.|先区分煅烧硬颗粒与软团聚粉；陶瓷用途关注铁污染和粒度尾部，抛光用途还需核查异物与划伤风险。|Distinguish hard calcined particles from soft agglomerates. Ceramic grades require control of iron contamination and coarse tails; polishing grades also require checks for foreign particles and scratching.|hard

21|氢氧化铝可作为阻燃填料和氧化铝原料，粒度影响树脂中的填充与分散。|Aluminium hydroxide is used as a flame-retardant filler and alumina feedstock, with size affecting filling and dispersion in resins.|控制过粗颗粒和吸油量变化，兼顾颗粒表面；工艺温度应与材料稳定性匹配，不能将热处理造成的变化当作单纯粉碎。|Control coarse particles and changes in oil absorption while monitoring surfaces. Match temperature to material stability and distinguish thermal changes from simple size reduction.|clean

22|炭黑是细颗粒碳材料，用于补强、着色和导电配方，原生颗粒与聚集体需要区分。|Carbon black is a fine carbon used for reinforcement, pigmentation and conductivity; primary particles and aggregates must be distinguished.|多数任务是打开软团聚并稳定计量，不是无限破坏聚集结构；对比分散性、堆积密度和粉尘回收率，评估可燃粉尘特性。|Many tasks concern soft agglomerates and stable dosing rather than destruction of aggregate structure. Compare dispersion, bulk density and dust recovery, including combustible-dust properties.|porous

23|磷酸钙包括不同钙磷比与晶相的材料，可作陶瓷、化工及其他配方原料。|Calcium phosphates comprise several calcium-to-phosphorus ratios and phases used in ceramics, chemicals and other formulations.|提供具体化合物、等级和用途；控制硬团聚与粗粒，若用于高纯配方应同时检验接触材质引入的杂质。|Specify compound, grade and use. Control hard agglomerates and coarse particles, and assess contact-material contamination where high-purity formulations are intended.|clean

24|纤维素是纤维状高分子材料，可用于填料、增稠和复合材料配方。|Cellulose is a fibrous polymer used in fillers, thickening systems and composites.|纤维长度与粒度并不等价；先进行适当切断和干燥调质，再比较机械粉碎后的纤维形态、流动性及批次均匀性。|Fibre length and particle size are not equivalent. Consider cutting and moisture conditioning before comparing fibre morphology, flow and batch uniformity after impact milling.|fibrous

25|发泡剂是按功能划分的一类配方原料，不同化学类型的分解温度和粉尘特性差异明显。|Blowing agents are a functional class of formulation ingredients with chemistry-dependent decomposition temperatures and dust properties.|必须提供化学身份和热稳定性资料；以分散均匀性为目标评估低温粉碎，遇到反应性或敏感配方应先完成专门的工艺适用性评估。|Provide chemical identity and thermal-stability information. Assess low-temperature size reduction for uniform dispersion, with a dedicated suitability assessment for reactive or sensitive formulations.|heat

26|低熔点玻璃粉用于封接、粘结及电子配方，其成分决定软化与热膨胀行为。|Low-melting glass frit is used in sealing, bonding and electronic formulations; composition determines softening and thermal-expansion behaviour.|控制粗粒、异物与颗粒分布，避免软化黏壁；铅系与无铅配方应分别评估接触材质、温度和收集方式。|Control coarse particles, foreign matter and size distribution without softening onto surfaces. Assess lead-containing and lead-free grades separately for contact materials, temperature and collection.|heat

27|氢氧化镁可用于阻燃填料与化工配方，颗粒分散影响填充效果和加工流动性。|Magnesium hydroxide is used in flame-retardant fillers and chemical formulations, where dispersion influences filling and processability.|比较解聚与晶体破碎的必要性，关注表面处理层、吸油量和粗颗粒；热气源使用前检查相态稳定性。|Compare the need for deagglomeration versus crystal fracture, considering surface treatment, oil absorption and coarse particles. Verify phase stability before using heated gas.|clean

28|氧化镁用于耐火、陶瓷及化工用途，轻烧、重烧和电熔等形态的硬度与活性不同。|Magnesia is used in refractories, ceramics and chemicals; light-burned, dead-burned and fused grades differ in hardness and reactivity.|明确煅烧等级、游离水和反应活性；气体湿度及收集储存影响结团，硬质牌号需核查磨耗和粗粒控制。|Specify calcination grade, free moisture and reactivity. Gas humidity and storage affect caking; hard grades also require wear and coarse-particle assessment.|moisture

29|沉淀硫酸钡是通过化学沉淀制得的填料，可用于涂料、塑料和相关精细配方。|Precipitated barium sulfate is a chemically produced filler used in coatings, plastics and fine formulations.|常见目标为干燥团聚体解聚与分布收窄；以分散性、白度和杂质控制评价工艺，避免把天然重晶石加工条件直接套用。|Typical goals are dispersing drying agglomerates and narrowing distribution. Evaluate dispersion, whiteness and impurities rather than applying natural-barite conditions unchanged.|pigment

30|硅胶是多孔二氧化硅材料，可用于吸附、载体和消光配方，含水与孔结构影响加工。|Silica gel is a porous silica used in adsorption, supports and matting formulations; moisture and pore structure affect processing.|区分颗粒型吸附剂和粉体级填料；粉碎可能改变颗粒强度与孔结构，应比较粒度、吸附或消光用途所需的性能。|Distinguish granular adsorbents from powder fillers. Milling can change particle strength and pores, so compare size with adsorption or matting performance requirements.|porous

31|碳酸锶可用于陶瓷、玻璃和磁性材料配料，是需要均匀分散的无机粉体。|Strontium carbonate is an inorganic powder used in ceramic, glass and magnetic-material formulations requiring uniform dispersion.|按后续反应或烧结需求确定粒度，控制粗粒与配料偏析；研磨介质与接触材质应满足杂质限值。|Set size requirements for subsequent reaction or sintering, controlling coarse particles and segregation. Milling and contact materials must meet impurity limits.|clean

32|白炭黑通常指沉淀法或气相法二氧化硅，用于橡胶、涂料等配方，不能仅凭俗名判断等级。|White carbon black usually denotes precipitated or fumed silica used in rubber and coatings; the common name alone does not identify the grade.|粉体蓬松、易扬尘且可能强团聚；需区分一次颗粒、聚集体与软团聚体，优先比较分散、供料稳定性和收集压差。|Low bulk density, dustiness and aggregation require distinctions between primary particles, aggregates and loose agglomerates. Prioritize dispersion, feed stability and collection pressure drop.|porous

33|氧化钇是稀土氧化物，可用于陶瓷、荧光及电子材料配方。|Yttrium oxide is a rare-earth oxide used in ceramic, phosphor and electronic-material formulations.|高纯用途重视异种元素污染，烧结原料重视团聚和分布；通过接触材质试样与解聚前后粒度对比确定路线。|High-purity uses emphasize foreign-element contamination, while sintering feedstocks emphasize agglomerates and distribution. Compare contact-material compatibility and size before and after deagglomeration.|clean

34|氧化锌用于橡胶、陶瓷、涂料及多种化工配方，不同用途对纯度和分散的要求不同。|Zinc oxide is used in rubber, ceramics, coatings and chemical formulations with application-specific purity and dispersion requirements.|先区分松散粉体与烧结团聚体；评估粗粒、比表面积和色泽，控制外来金属，并按目标配方验证分散效果。|Distinguish loose powder from sintered agglomerates. Assess coarse particles, surface area and colour, control foreign metals and verify dispersion in the intended formulation.|pigment

35|红柱石是铝硅酸盐矿物，可作为耐火材料原料，其矿物组成和杂质影响后续使用。|Andalusite is an aluminosilicate mineral used as refractory feedstock; mineral composition and impurities influence its use.|根据耐火配方要求选择粒级而非统一超细化；较硬原料先破碎，再比较粉碎分级后的级配与铁污染。|Select grades for the refractory formulation rather than assuming ultrafine powder is always desirable. Pre-crush hard feed and compare grading and iron contamination after milling and classification.|mineral

36|重晶石是以硫酸钡为主要成分的天然矿物，可作为加重材料和工业填料。|Barite is a natural barium-sulfate-rich mineral used as a weighting material and industrial filler.|高密度颗粒的分级表现与轻质粉不同；结合密度、白度、可溶杂质和目标粒级评价分级切割点及磨耗。|Dense particles classify differently from light powders. Assess cut size and wear together with density, whiteness, soluble impurities and required grades.|mineral

37|膨润土是以蒙脱石等黏土矿物为主要组分的天然材料，可用于黏结、吸附和流变调节。|Bentonite is a natural clay rich in montmorillonite-type minerals used for binding, adsorption and rheology control.|含水升高会改变黏性和供料；干燥调质需与膨胀/吸附用途匹配，避免仅追求细度而损害应用性能。|Moisture changes adhesion and feeding. Match drying and conditioning to swelling or adsorption requirements rather than pursuing fineness at the expense of function.|mineral

38|水镁石是天然氢氧化镁矿物，可作为阻燃、耐火或化工原料。|Brucite is a natural magnesium hydroxide mineral used in flame-retardant, refractory and chemical feedstocks.|与合成氢氧化镁不同，应先核查伴生矿物、白度和杂质；加工路线需要兼顾解离、分级与最终填料分散。|Unlike synthetic magnesium hydroxide, associated minerals, whiteness and impurities must first be checked. Consider liberation, classification and final filler dispersion together.|mineral

39|氧化钙是石灰类材料的主要成分，与水接触会发生明显反应，粉体处理需控制环境湿度。|Calcium oxide is the main component of quicklime and reacts with water, making humidity control important in powder processing.|确认有效氧化钙、残余碳酸盐和游离水；避免湿法供料与无控制潮气，评估密闭粉碎、干气分级及防潮收集。|Confirm available calcium oxide, residual carbonate and free water. Avoid wet feeding and uncontrolled moisture; assess enclosed milling, dry-gas classification and moisture-protected collection.|moisture

40|硅藻土是具有多孔结构的硅质沉积材料，可作过滤助剂、吸附剂及填料。|Diatomite is a porous siliceous sedimentary material used in filter aids, adsorbents and fillers.|过滤用途需要保留孔隙与渗透性，不能简单以越细越好评价；优先分级去除不合适粒级，并比较破碎后的结构变化。|Filter-aid use requires pore structure and permeability, so finer is not automatically better. Prioritize removal of unsuitable grades and compare structural changes caused by grinding.|porous
